scope: Current local disturbing-media classifier implementation and remaining acceptance gaps
finding: The pinned SwiftFormer ONNX model is vendored and integrated into the local media worker, category-specific policy, and UI flow. This is implemented but not fully accepted; it is not an absent-model finding.

assets.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0, locally vendored WASM assets under client/public/media-classifier/v2/

verification_evidence.summary: Current runtime record: pinned assets and actual ONNX model execute through production adapter on synthetic RGB input; worker, contract, aggregation and UI integration tests; full client suite and production build. Node/synthetic and mocked-worker evidence only; not browser or device acceptance.
Current preprocessing record: production preprocessor matches Pillow 13 reference hashes and participates in a synthetic real-model inference chain.
Local static-image analysis is connected to chat; unsupported animation/video and failures retain unknown-media policy.

historical_records.note: Earlier candidate probe; its statement that the app still reports disturbing analysis as unknown predates integration and is not current implementation evidence.
Contains earlier intermediate-state remaining/acceptance text; use its verified preprocessing evidence, not its pre-integration status statements, when describing current state.

remaining_gaps: Representative NSFL/gore quality and false-negative evaluation; threshold calibration is provisional, and the model card notes NSFL is underrepresented in training data.
Real browser worker execution and encoded-image decoder parity, including orientation, transparency and color-profile behavior.
Animation/video multi-frame analysis; those inputs remain unsupported/unknown rather than being treated as safe from a single frame.
Packaged Windows asset/CSP acceptance, real-device performance and two-client acceptance.
status_interpretation: The disturbing classifier implementation exists and is integrated. Quality, unsupported formats, packaging and acceptance remain open; no full acceptance or release is claimed.
actions_performed: Read-only audit; no coverage ledger changes, tests beyond JSON parsing, publication or deployment.
